purpose: Final mechanical census of legacy N0TE before repository deletion. Evidence only; no direct legacy source/test admission.

preserve_semantics: ARK is a bounded realtime audio transport boundary, not a second reasoning/product brain
stable C ABI separates realtime audio-plane implementation from control-plane reasoning
realtime callbacks perform bounded ring I/O only; file, analysis, UI, network and AI remain outside callbacks
external-source capture and device-backed capture share one bounded ARK state/counter contract
runtime-gate newer platform capture APIs instead of silently raising the whole application's OS floor
native dependencies are pinned by exact revision rather than floating upstream tags/branches
native build artifacts distinguish static test libraries from product-callable shared runtime artifacts
capture/playback snapshots expose callback counts, samples, overruns, underruns and last error
metadata discovery is not hosting
pin official SDK revision/provenance
instantiate an audio class and prove component/controller/processor availability
prove audio buses and at least one writable parameter
prove parameter mutation and readback
prove offline processing produces output
prove component state save/restore roundtrip
retain isolation/quarantine and real-plugin acceptance as separate later proofs
private runtime dependencies and third-party components require explicit manifests/provenance
platform build configuration is evidence, not semantic product scope
package and launcher behavior must be tested as consumer lifecycle behavior
minimum OS claims must match native binary deployment targets
update/uninstall/migration paths remain distinct from current product architecture

preserve_as_spec_only: studio environment and owned-tool profile semantics
offer suggestion from real work without silently becoming an external transaction
fan/audience evidence without pretending causal certainty
do_not_restore_topology: Ableton-era compatibility paths as canonical architecture

deletion_readiness.caveat: Deleting the GitHub repository destroys convenient browseability of GPL legacy implementation history. The migration decision is that N0TE2 does not require that implementation as a live dependency; exact historical commit/tree/blob provenance has been retained for the extracted quarry.
